title: Art Pipeline and Direction
acceptance: A headless Blender pipeline (games/haunted/art) builds, paints, previews and exports assets; HCM1 codec has matching Python and Luau specs; generated data syncs through Rojo with no upload or generator call.

A client ArtLoader renders HCM1 assets as EditableMesh MeshParts with shared templates, LOD switching and a fail-safe fallback; server builders place tagged ArtSlot anchors that keep the existing colliders, lights and interaction points.

SYS-Haunted-Art-Direction records the selected references (positive and rejected), style, palette, materials, budgets, the full asset/UI inventory with replace/refine/retain/new decisions, and the dual live path (jg batch import or Mesh/Image API toggle).
The lamp post family replaces the rejected lamps in game, compared with MIN-064/MIN-069 and BAD-015/016 in front, side, rear and three-quarter views, neutral and night light, and without glow.
scripts/check.sh passes; FullLoop still passes in Studio; EditableMesh memory and triangle cost measured.
